mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a quiet, clear night at Fireman's Park with a current temperature of 77 degrees, feeling like 81. A waxing crescent moon is lighting up the sky, though we will not have any visible space station passes tonight.

In city news, Verona is ramping up its sustainability efforts. The city has installed anti-idling technology in its new ambulance and is transitioning its police fleet to hybrid vehicles, earning recognition as a Bicycle Friendly Community. Additionally, residents can take advantage of rebates for installing rain barrels, rain gardens, and energy-efficient toilets to conserve water.

We have some great local events lined up. This Saturday, July 18, features the Mount Horeb Art Fair, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Louie. Looking ahead to next week, you can test your wits at Hop Haus Trivia on Tuesday, July 21, and shop fresh at the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22.

In the weekly police recap, officers responded to a vehicle versus bicycle crash on Friday, July 10, at the intersection of Old County Highway PB and Whalen Road. A bicyclist sustained minor injuries, and a Verona resident was cited for failing to yield the right of way.

If you are looking for a sweet treat today, the flavor of the day is Mint Cookie! Culver's of Verona is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out on today's minty goodness, tomorrow's flavor of the day will be the decadent Turtle.
